label: US traditional 401(k)
name: Name
contributionHelp: Enter the pre-tax contributions already accounted for in your payroll assumptions, including any employer contribution.
openingRmdHelp: If you start the plan partway through a year with a required minimum distribution, enter the amount still due. Use zero if already paid.
eligibleDate: First distribution date confirmed by the plan
eligibilityHelp: For plans with additional restrictions, enter the date the plan allows distributions. The forecast uses age 59½ for ordinary distributions.
workingDeferral: The plan permits delaying mandatory withdrawals while still employed
deferralHelp: Enter your expected separation date as the first distribution date. The working deferral requires plan permission and excludes 5% owners.
distribution: Distribution option allowed by the plan
annuityHelp: Use the plan's quoted lifetime payment after any required minimum distribution at conversion.
invalidPerson: Select one person with a valid birth year and month.
invalidContribution: Enter the date when projected contributions stop.
invalidEligibility: Enter the first date the employer plan allows distributions.
invalidDeferral: Confirm the retirement date for the permitted working deferral, or enter an eligibility date by the first required distribution year.
invalidOpeningRmd: Enter the remaining required distribution for the first calendar year.
invalidStart: Choose a start by age, date, retirement or milestone.
